# clickhouse_udf (Resource)

You can use the *clickhouse_udf* resource to create and manage User Defined Functions (UDFs) in ClickHouse Cloud.

~> **Note:** This resource is in beta. Its behavior may change in future provider versions.

Point `source_archive_path` at a ZIP of your function source, and set `source_archive_hash` to `filebase64sha256(...)` of that same file so Terraform knows when to publish a new version. On apply, the provider uploads the archive and waits for the build to finish.

### If a build fails

By default, a failed build fails the apply (`fail_on_build_error = true`). Set it to `false` if you'd rather get a warning and move on. Either way, the failed version stays in state, and applying again with the same source won't retry the build — you'll need to fix the source and give `source_archive_hash` a new value first.

On create, a failed build also taints the resource, so the next apply replaces it from scratch. On update, the previous, working version keeps running while you sort things out.

### If Terraform loses track mid-build

Occasionally Terraform can't confirm a publish went through, or polling for the build status times out. Either way, it stops rather than risk creating a duplicate version, and saves the last known status in state. A `terraform plan` (or `refresh`) will pick up the real status, so it's worth doing that before applying again.

### A couple of things to know

`function_name` can't reuse a built-in ClickHouse function name (like `sum`) — the API rejects reserved names.

Deleting this resource removes all versions of the UDF and detaches it from every service that uses it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clickhouse_udf" "echo_string" {
  function_name = "echo_string"
  runtime       = "python3.11"
  type          = "executable_pool"
  return_type   = "String"

  arguments = [
    { name = "input", type = "String" },
  ]

  source_archive_path = "${path.module}/echo_string.zip"
  source_archive_hash = filebase64sha256("${path.module}/echo_string.zip")

  pool_size                  = 5
  command_read_timeout       = 10000
  command_write_timeout      = 10000
  max_command_execution_time = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `arguments` (Attributes List) Arguments passed to the UDF command. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--arguments))
- `function_name` (String) Name of the UDF. Unique within the organization.
- `return_type` (String) ClickHouse data type of the returned value.
- `runtime` (String) Runtime used to execute the UDF command.
- `source_archive_hash` (String) Base64-encoded SHA-256 of the ZIP archive. A change publishes a new UDF version.
- `source_archive_path` (String) Local path to the ZIP archive uploaded by the provider.
- `type` (String) Executable UDF type.

### Optional

- `command_read_timeout` (Number) Command stdout read timeout in milliseconds.
- `command_write_timeout` (Number) Command stdin write timeout in milliseconds.
- `fail_on_build_error` (Boolean) When true (the default), a failed build fails the apply. The failed version stays in state. Changing this setting does not create a new UDF version.
- `format` (String) Input and output format used by the UDF command.
- `max_command_execution_time` (Number) Maximum command execution time in seconds for executable_pool UDFs.
- `pool_size` (Number) Command pool size for executable_pool UDFs.
- `return_name` (String) Name of the returned value, or null when unnamed.
- `sandbox_type` (String) Sandbox isolation level.
- `sandbox_version` (String) Sandbox runtime version.
- `send_chunk_header` (Boolean) Whether ClickHouse sends a row-count chunk header.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `error` (String) Build error, or null when no build error is present.
- `status` (String) Build state of this UDF version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Version number of the UDF.

<a id="nestedatt--arguments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `arguments`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the argument. Required for Native and JSONEachRow formats.
- `type` (String) ClickHouse data type of the argument.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import by function name.
terraform import clickhouse_udf.echo_string echo_string
```
